main_text.p: jiciunt, juxta ritus apud ipsos præscriptos, diversis locis & vicibus, septuagenos, juxta AlGazalium; quas conjicientem, oportere, ait, præter obsequium Deo præstandum sibi proponere التشبيهة بإبراهيم [?] حين عرض له ابليس في ذلك الموضع ليعين ضل على [?] حجه تشبيه او يفتنه بمعصية فامره الله تعالي ان يرميه بحجارة طردا له و قطعا للامله [?] Imitationem Abrahami, qui cum occurreret ipsi isto loco Diabolus, ut cultum ipsius injecto dubio, turbaret, aut ipsum ad inobedientiam tentaret, jussus est a Deo eum lapidem jactu fugare, ac spem ipsi omnem praecidere, و اعلم ذلك في الظاهر و ترمي الحصا الي العقبة وفي [?] الحقيقة ترمي به وجه الشيطان و نقصد به ظهر اذلا [?] حصل ارغام انفه الا بامتثالك امر الله [?] تعظيما [?] جرد الامر من غير حظ النفس و العقل فيه [?] Scias autem te specie quidem lapides in Akabah conjicere, at revera faciem Diaboli cædere, ac dorsum ipsi confringere, cum non aliàs ipsi vis inferatur quàm per obedientiam Deo à te præstitam ex mera mandati reverentia, nullis hac in re menti & intellectui partibus concessis. Sic Ahmed Iosephi filius, in vita Ismaelis dicit ان رمي الجمارات سبع ابراهيم لما تعرض له الشيطان Iactum istum lapillorum, ritum esse ab Abrahamo institutum, cum occurreret ipsi Diabolus, quando filium facrificatum iret. alii altius adhuc ritus huius originem deducunt, ab ipso scil. Adamo. quo spectat quod dictum

page.notes: The Arabic lines are read tentatively from a small, faint scan. Every doubtful Arabic word or phrase is marked [?], and the readings should be checked against the original before use. The Arabic lines run inline with the Latin, as they stand in the printed column. The long s has been normalised to plain s throughout; the gathering mark "Sf 3" was printed with a long-s form and is given as "Ss 3". The catchword "à Mo-" is a partial word, as printed. The scan shows a faint digitiser credit at lower right, which is not transcribed.
